name: Shinjou Takafumi
source:
He is a first-year student at Higashi Kasumigaoka private school. He attends the same school as his sister.

He secretly thinks of his sister as a woman. He misses his sister because she is getting busier and spending less and less time with him these days.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/anejoku/index.html]official site[/url]]
